description: This file contains utility functions for managing conversation history and session configurations in a chat agent system, including limiting message history and extracting history limits from session keys.

methods.name: stripThreadSuffix
methods.description: Removes thread or topic suffix from a string using regex.

methods.name: limitHistoryTurns
methods.description: Limits the conversation history to the last N user turns to reduce token usage.

methods.name: getHistoryLimitFromSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the history limit setting from a session key based on provider configuration.

methods.name: getDmHistoryLimitFromSessionKey
methods.description: Deprecated alias for getHistoryLimitFromSessionKey for backward compatibility.
